title: Add Dery Lau AI to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Dery Lau AI](https://derylau.my.id) to image
- Create collaborative images using the Pollinations image API

Fixes #13705

gist.headline: A new canvas joins
gist.blurb: Dery Lau AI has landed in the garden, giving collaborators a shared canvas powered by the Pollinations image API. More people making strange little pictures together: objectively good.
gist.summary: Added Dery Lau AI to the app directory, a collaborative image-making app built with the Pollinations image API.
gist.impact: People can now discover Dery Lau AI as a shared space for creating collaborative images with Pollinations generation.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy collaborative art table where several pixel canvases combine into one blooming image garden. Polli acts as the friendly painter and facilitator, using the Pollinations image API as a little glowing paint terminal; code-plants and flowers show that many contributors can grow one shared creation.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art art studio where Polli, a cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears a tiny painter's beret and helps arrange several shared pixel canvases into one blooming collaborative image garden beside a lime green (#ecf874) retro API terminal. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with code-plants, flowers, and subtle pixel-font text reading "CREATE TOGETHER"; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
